title: God's Calling You Out: Stop Making Excuses
changes: 1:1 복원: 'King Darius of Persia', 'Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel', 'Joshua son of Jehozadak' 복원 (이름·국가 누락)
1:5-6 복원: 'drinking and drinking and drinking' 3연타 복원, 'rusted-out' 복원
1:9-11 복원: 'stunting vegetables and fruit' 복원, 'not man or woman' 복원 (KO에는 이미 있었음)
1:12 복원: 'son of Shealtiel'/'son of Jehozadak' 복원, 'listened, really listened' 반복 복원
paragraphs: Alright, so check it. This went down on the first day of the sixth month, in the second year of the reign of King Darius of Persia. God's Message came through the prophet Haggai, and it was for Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, the governor of Judah, and for Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest.
This is what God-of-the-Angel-Armies had to say: 'My people are procrastinating. They're all like, 'Nah, it's not the right time to rebuild God's Temple.''

So a little later, God had more to say, and Haggai laid it all out: 'Oh, so it's the 'right time' for you all to be living in your slick new houses while MY house, the Temple, is a complete wreck? Make it make sense.'
And then God-of-the-Angel-Armies came back with more:

'Yo, take a good, hard look at your lives. Seriously, think about it. You're dropping a ton of cash, but you have basically nothing to show for it. You keep loading up your plates, but you're never actually full. You drink and drink and drink, but you're always thirsty. You're layering up clothes, but you can't get warm. And the people working for you? What are they getting? Pretty much nothing—like a leaky, rusted-out bucket. That's what.'
That's why God-of-the-Angel-Armies said:
'Take a good, hard look at your life. Think it over.'
Then God was like:

'Here’s the plan: Go up to the hills, chop down some trees, and bring the timber back to rebuild the Temple. Do it for me. Show me some respect. You had all these big dreams for yourselves, but it all came to nothing. And the little you did bring to my Temple? I just blew it away—it was nothing.'

'And why?' (This is a message from God-of-the-Angel-Armies, just so you know.) 'It's because while you've all been running around, busy fixing up your own houses, my house is a total ruin. That's why. Because you've been stingy. So I've hit you with a dry summer and a pathetic harvest. I've matched your tight fists with a drought, drying up the fields and hills, making your gardens and orchards wither, and stunting your vegetables and fruit. Nothing—not men or women, not animals, not crops—is gonna thrive.'

Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel the governor, Joshua son of Jehozadak the high priest, and all the people with them listened, really listened, to the voice of their God. When God sent Haggai the prophet to them, they paid attention. By listening to Haggai, they were showing God respect.
Then Haggai, God's messenger, gave the people God's message: 'I am with you!' That's God's Word.

And that's how God got Zerubbabel, Joshua, and all the people fired up—and they started working on the Temple of God-of-the-Angel-Armies. This all happened on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month, in the second year of King Darius.

title: God's Epic Temple Upgrade Is Coming
changes: 2:1-3 복원: 'son of Shealtiel'/'son of Jehozadak' 복원
2:5 복원: 'the word I covenanted' 복원 (promise로 약화돼 있었음)
2:8 수정: 'I own all the silver/gold' → 'I own the silver, I own the gold' (MSG에 없는 'all' 제거)
2:9 복원: 'wholeness' 복원 (peace로 오역), 'This new Temple' → 'This Temple' (MSG에 없는 'new' 제거)
2:10-12 복원: 'meat that is set apart for sacrifice on the altar' 복원, 'a loaf of bread, a dish of stew, a bottle of wine or oil' 세부 복원
2:14 복원: 4문장 병렬 복원 ('Their nation is contaminated' 누락이었음; 'offer me' → 'do for me' 오역 수정)
2:15-17 복원: 'Think back' 복원, 'the first foundation stones' 복원, 'half the grain you were used to, half the wine' 구체 수치 복원
2:18-19 복원: 'Now think ahead from this same date' 복원

2:21-23 복원: 'from top to bottom' 복원, 'armaments' 복원, 'killing one another' 복원, 'O Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, as my personal servant' 복원, 'the sign of my sovereign presence and authority' 복원, 'I've looked over the field' 복원, 'The Message of God-of-the-Angel-Armies' 마감 복원
장 전체: 'the God of the Angel Armies' → 'God-of-the-Angel-Armies'로 통일 (MSG 고유명)
2:1-3 복원: 'the Word of God' 복원 (MSG 고유 호칭; 'a message from God'에서 원복)
paragraphs: On the 21st day of the 7th month, the Word of God came through the prophet Haggai. He was told to say this to Governor Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, High Priest Joshua son of Jehozadak, and all the people: "Is anyone still around who saw the first Temple in all its glory? And what do you see now? Kinda pathetic, right?
"'So, get to work, Zerubbabel!'—this is God talking.
"'Get to work, Joshua, son of Jehozadak—the high priest!'
"'Get to work, all you people!'—God is saying.

"'Yeah, get to work! Because I am with you.' God-of-the-Angel-Armies is speaking! 'Live out the word I covenanted with you when you left Egypt. I am literally living and breathing among you right now. Don't be scared. Don't hold back.'

"This is what God-of-the-Angel-Armies said: 'In a little while, I'm going to shake up the sky and the earth, the ocean and the land. I'll shake up all the nations that don't know me. They'll bring tons of wealth, and I will fill this Temple with splendor.' God-of-the-Angel-Armies says so.
"'I own the silver, I own the gold.' Decree of God-of-the-Angel-Armies.

"'This Temple is going to be way better than the original. It had a glorious start, but the finish will be even more glorious. It will be a place where I give out wholeness and holiness.' Decree of God-of-the-Angel-Armies.

On the 24th day of the 9th month (this was in the second year of King Darius's reign), God's message came to Haggai again: "God-of-the-Angel-Armies says: 'Ask the priests for a ruling. If someone is carrying a piece of sacred meat in their pocket, meat that is set apart for sacrifice on the altar, and that pocket touches a loaf of bread, a dish of stew, a bottle of wine or oil, or any other food, will these foods be made holy by such contact?'"
The priests answered, "No."
Then Haggai asked, "What if someone becomes unclean by touching a dead body, and then they touch one of these foods? Does the food become unclean?"
The priests said, "Yes, it will become unclean."
Then Haggai said, "'So this people is contaminated. Their nation is contaminated. Everything they do is contaminated. Whatever they do for me is contaminated.' God says so.

"'Think back. Before you set out to lay the first foundation stones for my Temple again, how were things for you? Isn't it true that because you were dragging your feet and only giving a half-hearted effort to rebuild, your crops were also only giving you half of what you were used to—half the grain, half the wine? I sent drought and disease and hail. Everything you tried to do got messed up. But it didn't even seem to faze you. You just kept ignoring me.' God's decree.

"'Now think ahead from this same date—this 24th day of the 9th month. Think ahead from when the Temple rebuilding was launched. Has anything in your fields—your vines, fig trees, pomegranates, olive trees—failed to flourish? From now on, you can count on a blessing.'"
God's message came to Haggai a second time on that same important day, the 24th day of the 9th month: "Speak to Zerubbabel, the governor of Judah:

"'I am about to shake everything up, turn it all upside down and start over from top to bottom. I will overthrow governments, destroy foreign powers, and dismantle the world of weapons and armaments. I'll throw armies into confusion, so that they end up killing one another. And on that day'"—this is God's message—"'I will take you, O Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, as my personal servant and I will set you as a signet ring, the sign of my sovereign presence and authority. I've looked over the field and chosen you for this work.'" The Message of God-of-the-Angel-Armies.
